landing.title: Your ward. Your voice.
landing.lead: Raise local issues with your neighbours. The ones that matter rise to your constituency, county and the nation — transparently, never for sale.
landing.point.ward: Start in your ward, where you live
landing.point.elevation: See why posts rise — every score is explained
join.title: Join Civic
join.consent.name: Consent
join.consent.heading: Before you begin
join.consent.intro: To make sure every member is a real resident of their ward, we ask for your national ID number and phone number.
join.consent.purpose: Purpose: your ID is used only to confirm you are a real person and to place you in your ward. Never for advertising.
join.consent.storage: Storage: we keep only a secure one-way code of your ID, never the number itself. Your phone number is encrypted.
join.consent.access: Access: only you and, when the law requires, our Data Protection Officer.
join.consent.rights: Your rights: you can see, correct or delete your data, and withdraw consent at any time.
join.consent.checkbox: I agree to the processing of my national ID and phone number for these purposes.
join.consent.required: Please tick the box to agree before continuing.
join.consent.kslUnavailable: The sign-language video for this notice is being produced and will appear here.
join.identity.name: Your ID and phone
join.identity.idHint: 8 digits. It is never shown to anyone.
join.identity.phoneHint: We'll send a code to this number. Example: 0712 345 678
join.identity.phoneError: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, for example 0712 345 678.
join.ward.name: Your ward
join.ward.heading: Where do you live?
join.ward.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters, e.g. Kiamwangi
join.ward.noResults: No match. Try another spelling, or choose below.
join.profile.name: Your profile
join.profile.displayNameHint: Shown on your posts. You can use a nickname.
join.verify.name: Verify your phone
join.verify.heading: Enter the code we sent
join.verify.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {phone}.
join.verify.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the SMS or request a new code.
join.verify.resendIn: You can request a new code in {seconds} s
join.verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
join.error.alreadyRegistered: This national ID is already registered.
join.done.title: Welcome, {name}!
login.title: Log in
login.lead: Enter your national ID. We'll send a code to the phone you registered.
account.title: Your account
account.body: Your profile, language, display, security and privacy settings.
feed.title: Home
feed.empty.ward: No posts in your ward yet. Start the conversation.
feed.empty.level: Nothing has reached this level yet. Posts rise here when neighbours find them useful.
post.removed: This post was removed by a moderator.
why.title: Why you're seeing this
why.elevated: This post was elevated from {from} to {to} because its relevance score exceeded that level's threshold. Scores come from likes, replies, how many different people took part, and age — never from payment.
why.ward: This post is from your ward. Posts start here and rise only when neighbours find them useful.
sponsored.heading: Sponsored
composer.title: New post
composer.tooLong: Posts can be at most {max} characters.
composer.noChannels: Your ward has no channels you can post in yet.
composer.scope: Posts start in your ward and reach wider levels only if neighbours find them useful.
error.likeFailed: Your like wasn't saved. Please try again.
post.title: Post
post.unavailable: This post doesn't exist, or it's outside your ward, constituency and county.
thread.empty: No replies yet. Be the first to respond.
reply.label: Your reply
channel.readOnlyNote: Announcements: only the channel's creator posts here.
channel.unavailable: This channel doesn't exist, or it belongs to another ward.
createChannel.title: Create a channel
createChannel.name: Name
createChannel.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, e.g. water-points.
createChannel.nameInvalid: Use 2–40 lowercase letters or numbers, with single hyphens between words.
createChannel.nameReserved: That name is reserved. Please choose another.
createChannel.nameTaken: Your ward already has a channel with that name.
reason.label: Harm
report.title: Report this post
report.intro: Report only real harm. Disagreeing with a post, or criticism of a leader, isn't a reason to report it.
report.sent: Report sent. Moderators will review it.
moderation.frozen: Under review by moderators — reason: {reason}. Likes and replies are paused.
appeal.title: Appeal this decision
appeal.statement: Why should this decision be reversed?
appeal.filed: Appeal filed. A decision is due by {date}.
mod.title: Moderation queue
mod.notModerator: You don't moderate any group, so there's no queue for you.
action.label: Decision
action.confirm: {action} this post? The author will be told why and can appeal within 14 days.
action.outOfAuthority: This post is above your authority: you moderate up to {level} level.
history.title: Decision history
reason.required: Choose the harm this post causes.
moderation.statementInvalid: Explain your appeal in 1 to 2000 characters.
account.displayNameHint: Shown on your posts and replies.
account.wardNote: Your ward is set when you register, so posts reach the right neighbours.
account.mfaHint: A code from an authenticator app, needed for moderation and other trusted roles.
account.mfaStep1: Add this key to an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Aegis):
account.mfaStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows:
account.mfaCodeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from your app.
account.consentWithdrawn: Withdrawn on {date}. You can read, but you can't post, like or report.
account.withdrawBody: You'll still be able to read your ward's posts, but you won't be able to post, reply, like or report until you consent again.
account.erasureHint: We erase your personal data within 30 days. Some records are kept where the law requires it.
account.erasureBody: You'll be signed out on every device. Your posts will show as “[deleted user]”. This can't be undone.
account.erasurePending: Account deletion requested on {requested}; it will be complete by {due}.
account.erasureDone: Your account is being deleted. It will be complete by {date}.
rail.label: More from your area
rail.houseBody: Verified civic organisations can sponsor messages here. They're shown by area — never by what you read or like.
rail.levelsBody: Every post starts in its ward. When neighbours find it useful — likes, replies, many different people taking part — it rises to the constituency, then the county, then the nation.
